notes: Paper places new 95% CL upper limits on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon via patchy dark screening of the CMB, cross-correlating Planck NILC maps with unWISE galaxies. Not a dark-matter search (CMB photons converting to dark photons in LSS), so no local DM density assumption. Exact limit curve is in Fig. 3 (not machine-readable here); data points reconstructed from text statements: epsilon < 4e-8 over most of 1e-13 to 1e-11 eV, strongest constraint epsilon < 2.08e-8 near mA' ~ 5.2e-13 eV, scan range 1.5e-13 to 9.7e-12 eV, with weakening toward the edges (endpoint values ~1e-7 approximate from Fig. 3 axis range). Points between the anchors are interpolated/approximate.
